title: From the Vault: Relics: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.
"Know your foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses." —Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist
"It offers you what you want, not what you need." —Braids, dementia summoner
Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.
"I will go to any length to achieve my goal. Eternal life is worth any sacrifice." —Zur the Enchanter
